summary: Keen Vision Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder-approved amendments to its trust agreement and charter. The trust amendment permits up to four three-month extensions of its business-combination deadline to July 27, 2027, each funded by $30,000 deposits. KVAC issued an unsecured, non-interest-bearing $30,000 promissory note to sponsor KVC Sponsor LLC, convertible into units at $10.00, to fund the first extension. The filing also notes adoption of amended articles. This is a routine SPAC extension and disclosure, not a special-situation event like a merger or liquidation.
